GitHub - aleokdev/dmc: An implementation of Dual Marching Cubes (DMC ...
This crate defines a fast implementation for the Dual Marching Cubes technique, also known as Linear Hashed Marching Cubes, along with a concurrent octree structure for storing node data. Unlike isosurface, this crate does NOT expect Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) or use them in any way.
